skill.summary: Send and receive direct messages on OpenAnt. Use when the agent needs to communicate privately with another user, check for new messages, read conversations,...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the send-message skill for OpenAnt.
- Enables sending and receiving direct messages, checking message notifications, reading conversations, and replying privately.
- Fully supports all standard DM command flows via the OpenAnt CLI with structured JSON output.
- Includes step-by-step guidance for message management and error handling.
- Designed for secure, private communication between users outside of public task threads.
